question: By what agency and will does the yoginī named Icchā operate up to māyā?
premises: Operation extends up to māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī Icchā, associated with the siddhas, operates up to māyā by supreme will.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between siddhaiḥ and māyāntaṃ is ambiguous.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, with the siddhas, extends up to māyā by supreme will.
